label: assm2
title: Assumption
body_md:
\label{assm2}
	The local objective functions $f_i, i=1,...,n$ are twice continuously differentiable, and there exist constants $0<m_1\le m_2<\infty$ such that for any $x \in {\mathbb{R}^n}$, $m_1I\preceq \nabla^2f_i(x)\preceq m_2I$
head: environment

title: Remark
body_md: Assumption \ref{assm2} is standard in the convergence analysis , see {\cite{boyd2004convex}}. The lower bound { $m_1$} of $\nabla^2f_i(x)$ implies that the local objective function $f_i$ is strongly convex, and thus the objective function { $f_i$} has a unique global minimum point. The upper bound $m_2$ of $\nabla^2f_i(x)$ means that the local objective function $f_i$ is smooth.

title: Lemma
body_md: Under the { condition} of Assumption \ref{assm2}. DOCMC algorithm  converges if {  the weighted matrix $R$} is selected appropriately.
